name: Nefeltari Vivi
title: Instantly activate [When Attacking] effects with this fast attack-and-draw deck!
desc: Leader Vivi makes up for being unable to attack by giving any Character the power to attack with [Rush] and allowing you to draw one card. This medium- to high-speed deck enables the seamless activation of powerful [When Attacking] effects as you spring unexpected attacks on your opponent.

cards.name: Nefeltari Vivi
cards.text:
This Leader cannot attack.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] ➁ (You may rest the specified number of DON!! cards in your cost area.): Draw 1 card and up to 1 of your Characters gains [Rush] during this turn.
(This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

cards.name: Otama
cards.text: [On Play] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Nami
cards.text: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your Leader or 1 of your Characters.

cards.name: Igaram
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may rest this Character and give your 1 active Leader −5000 power during this turn: Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Alabasta} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops
cards.text: [When Attacking] You may give your 1 active Leader −5000 power during this turn: Return this Character to the owner's hand at the end of this turn.

cards.name: Nico Robin
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 power or less.

cards.name: Koza
cards.text: [When Attacking] You may give your 1 active Leader −5000 power during this turn: This Character gains +2000 power until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Chaka
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] If your Leader is [Nefeltari Vivi], give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −3000 power during this turn. Then, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 0 power or less.

cards.name: Marco
cards.text:
[Your Turn] [On Play] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 power or less.
[On K.O.] You may trash 1 Event from your hand: You may play this Character card from your trash rested.

cards.name: Pell
cards.text: [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 4000 power or less.

cards.name: Roronoa Zoro
cards.text: [On Play] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Nefeltari Vivi
cards.text:
All of your red Characters with a cost of 3 or more other than this Character gain [Rush].
(This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

cards.name: Donquixote Doflamingo
cards.types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea/Donquixote Pirates
cards.text: [On Play] Return up to 1 Character with a cost of 7 or less to the owner's hand.

cards.name: Happiness Punch
cards.text: [Counter] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards −2000 power during this turn. Then, if your Leader is active, give up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards −1000 power during this turn.

cards.text: [Main] If your Leader has the {Alabasta} type, give up to 2 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.
